Does Brad Pitt die in Johnny Suede?

He plays Johnny Suede.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Learns life is more than a pair of suede shoes.

Pompadoured wannabe rock star Johnny gets magic black suede shoes, chases bohemian Darlette (and dodges her gun-toting boyfriend), pawns his guitar, and loses her. He forms a band with Deke and ends up with the smarter Yvonne, who teaches him there are more important things than shoes. Comic drift, no death.

Pitt's first true starring vehicle in the U.S.
